producer: tools/analysis-rerun.mjs driving papers/qrs-yield-analysis.html at the paper cohort size

inputs.note: the cohort is generated inside the page from committed code (cohort-gen.js + the FULL-lane renderers in cohort-full.js and synth-gen.js), so the run reads no capture corpus

publishedIn: papers/qrs-yield.html Table 1, the re-measured 2026-10-27 row set (re-measured again 2026-11-27)

population.note: 400 sampled patients give one window per arm; 362 of them yield a scorable ECG window and 365 a scorable PPG window. The two arms exclude different patients, so the counts differ.

claims.note: values EXACTLY as papers/qrs-yield.html prints them, so each `CLAIM … FROM …#claims/<key>` marker compares equal. Full precision sits under `result`.

notBound.rule: a marker is written only where the measurement reproduces the printed digits exactly. A printed cell that rounds the measurement is listed here, with both numbers, and it stays unbound.

sectionProse.note: §3.1 prints the PPG SQI pair as 0.986 and 0.977, and §3.2 prints the median bias as −10.4 %. The same rounding applies, so those stay unbound. The −3.92 ms beside them is bound.

approximations.note: §2.3, §6 Table 2 and the Table 1 caption print ≈363 windows per arm, ≈188,000 true beats per arm and ≈25,000 apnea beats. An approximation names no digits to bind. The measured apnea beats are 24184 (ECG) and 25040 (PPG).

result.framing: FULL-lane beat-yield. One ~9-min apnea-cluster window per patient per arm. ECG: CohortFull.renderECGInt16 → ECGDSP.analyze (real Pan-Tompkins); truth = deviceRR. PPG: SYNTH.renderPPG → PPGDSP.analyze (real optical pulse pipeline); truth = SYNTH.buildRR in-window. Recall = PAT-corrected beat match (±120 ms) of true beats, stratified by the master timeline apnea/hypopnea windows. SQI = the detector's own per-beat signal-quality in those segments. rMSSD bias = detected − local-median-cleaned true. SYNTHETIC GROUND TRUTH — certifies ECG yield-robustness and isolates the modest PPG apnea yield dip + over-detection and the resulting HRV bias; not a real-patient miss rate.

ECG.rmssdNote: faithful (R-peaks rendered at true beat times; reference arm)
